svg.text: Unchanged macro layout. Units meters / Z-up. Physical source edits pending independent layout checks.

Repeat all supported spawn offsets / standing and crouched eyes.
Slab begins ~.008m before the cap plane.
Overlap exaggerated. Tread and landing tops stay at +4m.
Analogous overlap at feet and +2m landing ends.
No player, support tolerance, step or route changes.
